author: Richie Mills
title: Allen Graves receives 2026 NBA Draft Green Room invitation - NewsBreak
text:
By Richie Mills No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
NEW YORK — A promising sign for a former Ponchatoula basketball star.
Allen Graves is one of 20 prospects who received a 2026 NBA Draft Green Room invitation.
This means that Graves should hear his name called in round one of the showcase that begins Tuesday at 7 p.m. on WGNO and ABC affiliates.
Allen Graves led Ponchatoula High School to back-to-back Division I Non-Select state championships and was named Gatorade Player of the Year after his senior year with the Green Wave.
Graves signed with Santa Clara after his decorated high school career.
After redshirting his first year on campus, the 6’9 phenom was named West Coast Conference Freshman of the Year and Sixth Man of the Year in 2026.
Graves’ WCC All-Freshman campaign also helped Santa Clara reach the WCC conference tournament championship for the first time since 2007 and the NCAA Tournament for the first time since 1996.
His draft stock picked up steam at the start of conference play, and at last check, NBA Draft analysts like Jeremy Woo have Allen Graves going 20th overall to the San Antonio Spurs.
